root_cause.text: In the failure path of ib_umem_dmabuf_get_pinned_with_dma_device(), dma_buf_unpin() was called immediately after ib_umem_dmabuf_map_pages() failed, but the `umem_dmabuf->pinned` flag remained set, causing a duplicate dma_buf_unpin() call later when ib_umem_release() runs ib_umem_dmabuf_revoke().
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states: "the dmabuf is immediately unpinned but the umem_dmabuf->pinned flag is still set. Then, when ib_umem_release() is called, it calls ib_umem_dmabuf_revoke() which will call dma_buf_unpin() again." The patch removes the `err_unpin` label and its `dma_buf_unpin` call, redirecting to `err_release` instead.
